subject: McGlynn Elementary School Welcome Address
overview: Principal Andy O'Brien welcomed families for the 2022-2023 school year and outlined the school's educational philosophy and communication protocols.

items.title: Welcome and School Philosophy
items.summary: Principal Andy O'Brien introduced the school staff and described a child-centered learning environment serving over 500 students.

items.title: Specialized Language Programs
items.summary: The principal noted that the school hosts the Access and Newcomer English Language Learner programs.

items.title: Parental Engagement and Communication
items.summary: O'Brien encouraged parents to stay involved by monitoring the school website and reading monthly newsletters distributed via email.
